card.name: Digits inside numbers, mostly in counts
card.fires_on: Single digits partway through a multi-digit number, such as the 7 in 75 or the 2 in 2,224. Also fires on the gap or word just before such numbers, as in passenger counts or ages.

modes.label: Digits in counts and ages
modes.description: A digit inside a larger number in a story about passengers, deaths or age.
modes.example: On this day in 1891, Moby Dick writer Herman Melville died at the age of <<7>>2.

card.plain: It fires on a digit in the middle of a number, usually before the number is finished.
